scenario: After a quarter of form fills and list imports, scan HubSpot contacts for records sharing a normalized email (case, dots, plus-tags) and merge them into the oldest record, keeping the most recent lifecycle stage and owner.
rule_hooks: merge survivorship rules, lifecycle stage precedence

scenario: Weekly, read the Mailchimp bounce report and unsubscribe or archive every audience member with a hard bounce or three consecutive soft bounces, logging each removal to a deliverability Google Sheet.
After a Zoom webinar, compare the registrant list against the attendee report and re-tag each HubSpot contact as attended, no-show, or watched-on-demand based on minutes viewed.
Monthly, scan draft email campaigns in the marketing automation tool untouched for 90+ days and archive them, Slacking each creator a list of what was archived.
rule_hooks: staleness age threshold, protected campaign prefixes

scenario: Scan the campaign link tracker Google Sheet for UTM source/medium values that don't match the approved taxonomy (e.g. 'LinkedIn', 'linked_in', 'li') and rewrite them to the canonical value, flagging unknown ones.
Review Salesforce leads created last month with Lead Source blank or 'Other' and fill it from the original HubSpot form submission or UTM source recorded on the matched contact.

For a trade show campaign in Salesforce, compare campaign members against the badge-scan export in Google Sheets and update member status to Visited Booth, Registered-Not-Attended, or add missing scanned leads.
rule_hooks: campaign member status values, match on email then name+company

scenario: Ahead of a privacy audit, find HubSpot contacts with an EU country and no recorded marketing consent older than the consent-refresh deadline, set them to non-marketing and remove them from all active lists.
rule_hooks: EU country list, consent age policy

scenario: Before sending a conference attendee list to the venue, scan Eventbrite orders for duplicate registrations by the same attendee email and cancel/refund the later duplicates, noting each in a tracking sheet.
After a marketing rep leaves, find all HubSpot contacts and Salesforce leads owned by the deactivated user and reassign them by territory to the current SDR roster.
Every Monday, read last 14 days of Meta Ads performance and pause ad sets whose cost per lead exceeds 2x the campaign target with at least $300 spend, posting a summary to #paid-media.
rule_hooks: CPL target per campaign, minimum spend threshold

scenario: When a seasonal promotion ends, scan Shopify discount codes tied to that campaign and deactivate any still active past the end date, updating the promo calendar sheet.
rule_hooks: campaign end dates, code naming convention

scenario: After a product launch is delayed, scan the Buffer/Hootsuite queue for scheduled posts mentioning the launch hashtag or URL and move them back to drafts, notifying the social manager in Slack.
rule_hooks: launch keyword list, new launch date

scenario: Following a content taxonomy revamp, read every published WordPress post's legacy tags and replace them with the new category set using the mapping doc, flagging posts with no mapping.
Scan the content asset tracker sheet for gated asset URLs returning 404 or pointing to retired landing pages and update them to the replacement URL or mark the asset as retired.
After marketing ops changes the scoring model, recompute score-tier properties for all open MQLs in HubSpot and demote those falling below the new MQL threshold back to lead status.
Scan nurture lists for contacts whose email domain belongs to a known competitor and remove them from all marketing lists, tagging them as competitor.
Quarterly, review HubSpot landing pages tied to campaigns that ended over 60 days ago and unpublish them with a redirect to the evergreen resource page, logging each change.
rule_hooks: campaign end date, redirect destination rules

scenario: At month close, compare Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads spend per campaign against bills in QuickBooks and correct the campaign class coding on mis-categorized bills, flagging variances over 5%.
Scan contacts with free-text job titles and set the persona and seniority fields (e.g. 'VP Eng', 'Head of Engineering' -> Engineering Leader / VP) so segmentation lists populate correctly.

After a bot attack on the demo request form, find contacts created in the attack window with gibberish names, disposable email domains, or identical IPs and delete them, removing any Salesforce leads they synced.
Weekly, compare unsubscribes in Mailchimp, HubSpot, and the SMS tool and apply each opt-out to every system where the person is still subscribed.
When a campaign is marked complete in the planning sheet, scan its Asana project for still-open tasks and close or move them to the backlog based on task type, then archive the project.
Scan HubSpot contacts with country and state values like 'USA', 'U.S.', 'Calif.' and rewrite them to ISO standard values so regional routing and webinar invites work.
Review the influencer partnership tracker against DocuSign envelopes and update each creator's status to Signed, Pending, or Expired, chasing envelopes older than 10 days via email.
After importing a purchased account list into Salesforce, find accounts duplicating existing ones by website domain and merge them, preserving the existing owner and ABM tier.
When sales leadership publishes the new quarter's target account list in Google Sheets, re-tier Salesforce accounts to Tier 1/2/3 and downgrade any accounts dropped from the list.

Ahead of an ESP contract renewal, find subscribers with no opens or clicks in 12 months who also haven't visited the site, send them to a sunset segment, and archive those who were already sunsetted last quarter.
After moving recordings from Zoom to Vimeo, scan the on-demand follow-up emails and HubSpot contact properties holding old Zoom recording URLs and replace them with the new links.
After a pricing change, scan the Google Drive collateral folder and Highspot for documents referencing old plan names or prices, move them to an Archive folder, and notify owners in Slack.
rule_hooks: deprecated plan names and price list

scenario: Compare the event sponsorship tracker against Xero invoices and payments, mark sponsors as Paid, Partially Paid, or Overdue, and email overdue sponsors a reminder.

Scan all active LinkedIn and Google Ads for destination URLs missing required UTM parameters or using the wrong campaign value and update the tracking templates to match the campaign naming convention.
rule_hooks: required UTM params, campaign naming convention

scenario: Monthly, scan Salesforce leads in Recycled status for 90+ days and return those with new engagement activity to Nurture, while marking those with no activity and invalid phones as Disqualified.

Compare partner referral form submissions against Salesforce opportunities and set the Partner Referral field on opportunities missing it, removing attribution where the referral came after opp creation.
Before quarterly reporting, find HubSpot contacts, deals, and form submissions created by internal test addresses or with 'test' names and delete them so funnel metrics aren't inflated.
rule_hooks: internal domain list, test naming patterns

scenario: Scan Zendesk tickets tagged 'email complaint' or containing 'stop emailing' from the last 30 days, unsubscribe the requesters in the ESP, and close the tickets with a confirmation macro.
After consolidating five newsletters into two, migrate each subscriber's old topic subscriptions to the new subscription types per the mapping and remove the deprecated subscription types.
Compare HubSpot lifecycle stages against active subscriptions in Stripe and set paying customers to Customer, churned accounts to Former Customer, so they exit prospect nurture sequences.
After the events team finalizes the annual event calendar, scan the shared marketing Google Calendar for placeholder holds for events not on the final list and delete them, notifying invitees.
rule_hooks: final event list, hold naming convention

scenario: Scan the DAM/brand asset library for published images used in social posts lacking alt text or usage-rights expiry, mark expired-rights assets as restricted, and create review tasks for missing alt text.

After the agency handoff, marketing ops scans Mailchimp for overlapping audiences (e.g. 'Newsletter 2023' vs 'Newsletter - Main'), merges subscribers into the canonical audience preserving tags, and archives the redundant audience. Triggered by the quarterly list-hygiene review.

Finance flags that closed-won Salesforce opportunities from Q3 lack a Primary Campaign; ops reads each opp's contact roles and earliest campaign-member response, then sets Primary Campaign Source per the first-touch policy.
Before a CRM audit, ops lists custom HubSpot contact properties with under 1% fill rate and no workflow references, archives them, and logs each archived property in a Google Sheet for sign-off.
After the channel restructure, the video team scans all YouTube uploads, moves each into the new product-line playlists by title keyword, and removes it from deprecated playlists.

Legal asks marketing to check the stock-photo license register in Airtable against assets in the DAM; any asset whose license expired is unpublished and tagged 'license-expired', and the owning designer is pinged in Slack.
Ops scans recent HubSpot contacts for typo domains (gmial.com, yaho.com, outlok.com), corrects them where the mapping is unambiguous, and marks the rest 'needs review' rather than emailing them.
Monthly backlog grooming: creative-request tickets in the Jira Marketing board with no activity for 60 days are closed as 'Won't Do' with a comment, and the requester is notified via Slack DM.
After a field-marketing reorg, every upcoming event in the events tracker Sheet and its linked Salesforce campaign is reassigned to the new regional manager per the territory map.
The paid team scans Meta Ads Manager for creatives not attached to any active ad in 90 days and archives them, keeping any tagged 'evergreen', then posts a count summary to #paid-media.
Ops renames Salesforce campaigns created this year that don't follow the 'YYYY-QN_Channel_Region_Name' convention, deriving parts from campaign type, start date and owner region.
After a Zoom webinar series, ops compares Zoom registrant exports with HubSpot contacts, creates missing contacts, and fixes mismatched company names using the email domain lookup.
HR shares the monthly leavers list; marketing removes those people from internal seed lists, test sends, and Slack approval channels used in campaign QA.
The budget-tracking Sheet mixes EUR and USD entries from regional teams; ops converts all planned and actual spend to USD using the finance month-end rate table and flags rows lacking a currency.
When product management sends the EOL list, the web team unpublishes the matching CMS product and comparison pages, sets 301 redirects to the successor product, and updates the sitemap tracker.
Intercom has visitors captured as leads who later signed up as users; ops merges leads into the matching user by email, preserving conversation history and lead source attribute.
The customer-marketing tracker in Asana has case studies stuck in 'Pending customer approval'; ops checks DocuSign for completed release forms and moves those to 'Approved', chasing the rest.

Compliance requires SMS consent be refreshed every 18 months; ops scans the SMS platform for subscribers whose consent date is older, moves them to a re-permission segment and stops them from active sends.
Booth badge scans were uploaded to the wrong Salesforce campaign; ops uses the scan date and event location in the lead notes to move each lead to the correct trade-show campaign.
In the optimization tool, tests that reached significance or ran past their end date are stopped, the winning variant is noted in the experiment log Sheet, and the test is archived.

Legal updated the required physical address and unsubscribe text; ops scans all active email templates in HubSpot, updates footers that use the old address, and lists templates with custom footers for manual review.
For the new nurture program, ops scans the gated-asset library in the Sheet and tags each asset TOFU/MOFU/BOFU based on asset type and topic, writing the tag back to the HubSpot file manager.
At fiscal year end, campaign folders in the marketing Google Drive older than two years are moved to the Archive shared drive, with sharing restricted and a manifest Sheet updated.
The swag vendor's shipment report is compared with the event-swag tracking Sheet; quantities are corrected, backordered items flagged, and the events team notified of shortfalls for upcoming shows.
Ops finds contacts where HubSpot lifecycle stage disagrees with the Salesforce lead status; each mismatch is corrected according to the field-sync ownership rules, with exceptions logged.
The weekly attribution Sheet is inflated by bot clicks; ops removes rows whose IPs or user agents match the known-bot list and recomputes channel totals.
Before the user conference, the events team compares each speaker's latest title and headshot in the speaker-intake form responses with the agenda pages and updates outdated entries.
The shared webinar Zoom account has recurring meetings tied to cancelled programs; ops cross-checks against the active program list and deletes the orphans, emailing hosts first.
In Google Tag Manager, ops scans tags for duplicate Meta and LinkedIn pixels firing on the same triggers, pauses duplicates, and records changes in the tag-governance Sheet.

After the new segmentation model (SMB/Mid-market/Enterprise by employee count) was approved, ops updates the Segment field on all open Salesforce leads using enrichment data and re-routes those that changed segment.
After a price change, marketing scans the sales enablement Notion pages and Google Docs for the old price points, updates them, and flags PDFs that need a designer.
Quarterly access review: users with no login in 90 days across Google Ads and LinkedIn Campaign Manager are removed, except agency accounts on the active contract list.

Dozens of near-identical demo-request forms exist across landing pages; ops maps each to the canonical form, swaps the embed on live pages, and archives the variants after confirming no recent submissions.
The direct-mail vendor sends a return-to-sender file; ops flags those contacts' mailing addresses as invalid in the CRM and removes them from the next physical mailer list.
Partner MDF claims in the tracking Sheet are matched against proof-of-performance submissions; approved claims are marked payable in QuickBooks, incomplete ones returned to partners via email.
The product's G2 and Capterra profile categories drifted after a rebrand; ops reviews each listing against the positioning doc and submits corrections, logging them in the brand-listings Sheet.
The podcast guest tracker in Airtable has the same guest entered by multiple producers; ops merges duplicates keeping the latest status and combining outreach notes.

The marketing automation integration log shows records that failed to sync to Salesforce due to validation errors; ops fixes the fixable fields (picklist values, missing company) and re-triggers sync for each.
Finance asks marketing to clean up Q3 expenses in Xero miscoded as 'General'; each is recoded to Events, Paid Media, Software, or Content based on vendor and memo.
Before an upsell campaign send, ops checks Zendesk for customers with open high-priority tickets and adds them to the campaign's suppression list, notifying the CSM in Slack.
Social team scans the UGC tracker of reposted customer photos; posts without a recorded rights-granted reply are removed from scheduled reposts and the creator is DMed a permission request.
